title: web3AnalyticsDashBoard
tagline: Web3 Analytic Dashboard present an interoperable AI Dashboard to query Web3 metadata in a scientific  context
description: Web3 Analytic Dashboard present an interoperable AI Dashboard to query Web3 metadata in a scientific  context, using for this hack Covalent and NFTPort API.There are no web3 collaborative  standard dashboard that integrates the AI power in Big Data & Data Science with standard web3 .This is extremely important to integrate in the future metaverse in order to have relevant information for informed decision making.
how_its_made: This project use Google Collab environment  as a frontend and integrates Web3 in a blockchain context using pandas to interact with data Collections . There are no web3 collaborative  standard dashboard that integrates the AI power in Big Data & Data Science with standard web3 .This is extremely important to integrate in the future metaverse in order to have relevant information for informed decision making.
